prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Redesigning the sign_in page for account sync clarity was helpful (+8.0% win) with accurate predictions, but sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect and predictions were too high.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow (new_flow) on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win), though predicted slightly high (+10.0%); other adoption page modifications showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8% loss), where predictions (+5.0%) were far too high.
Layout and hint modifications on the choose_path page showed no clear effect, and predictions were consistently too high.
Finish page modifications (redesigns and hints) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Home page modifications (waiting info, new flows, and notification prompts) showed no clear effect across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +7.4% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +7.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +2.7% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -5.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +4.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.7% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: +4.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +8.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interaction Basics Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen right before home_intro that highlights basic companion interaction shortcuts and controls. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries about how to interact with, hide, or control pets after completing onboarding, and finish page completion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Companion Quick Start Redesign: Redesign home_intro layout into a clean welcome dashboard displaying initial desktop launch status and primary key bindings. (why: Finish stage median time is 395s with high variance (mean 5815s) and 64.8% completion, indicating confusion at the final step.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Status Indicator: Provide detailed step-by-step creation stage indicators while pet assets load during the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen has a high mean time (2336s) and median of 201s, causing uncertainty during asset compilation.)
3: [home, notification] Background Pet Preparation Audio Completion Notification: Add an optional ready notification alert switch so users know when background generation completes. (why: Home wait median time is 201s and mean is over 38 minutes, indicating users switch to other apps while waiting.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Companion Journey Path Selection Copy: Simplify headline and body copy on choose_path to emphasize low-friction adoption. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s despite 8s median, showing some users get stuck or leave the app open on this step.)

scores.note: Finish step has high drop-off and support evidence, but finish modifications have consistently failed and adding a screen requires high cost.
Finish page redesigns showed negative performance (-8.3%) in earlier tests.
Home wait_info modifications showed no clear positive effect (-1.7% across 3 tests).
Home notification prompt showed mild positive results (+4.8% in 1 test).
Simple copy change on choose_path is config-only, but historical lift for hints/layout is minimal (+2.1%).
